name: Suances (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue with a red bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Suances (a tree, a tower and a ship above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Suances; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
